Alex: Heads-up: CloudMeter charged us twice for Feb-March on invoice CM-2026-02 (pilot + renewal). Link: https://cloudmeter.example/invoice/CM-2026-02
Sana: Ouch. Can you paste the invoice summary and PO? we need to map to the contract. cc @Priya
Alex: Summary:
Item: CloudMeter pilot Feb 2026 - $6,200
Item: CloudMeter annual renewal Mar 2026 - $9,800
Tax: $0
Total: $16,000
PO: PO-99221
Priya: Opening vendor dispute. Recommended ask: pro-rata credit for pilot ($6,200) OR convert to credit note applied against next quarter + move to consolidated quarterly billing starting 2026-05-01. Need finance sign-off for accepting credit note.
Tom: Usage logs show Feb spike from benchmark runs. I attached run IDs and start/end times to the ticket. That should support the pro-rata claim.
billing-bot: Uploaded invoice: https://files.redwood/invoices/CM-2026-02.pdf :page_facing_up:
procurement-bot: Ticket created TKT-5901 "CloudMeter double-charge dispute + cadence change" assigned to Priya. SLA 72h.
Priya: @Legal-Bot please review suggested amendment language: change billing cadence to quarterly, payment net 30, include credit note >= $6,200 for overlap. If legal okay, procurement will accept a credit note instead of refund.
Legal-Bot: Noted. Will review and send redline by EOD. Include contract ID CT-2025-CM.
Alex: Thanks everyone — aiming to close before Apr 12 to keep accounting tidy. Priya, looping you as owner for follow-up.
